name: WoodWard's Gripe Water 130ml | Made in India
description:
WoodWard’s Gripe Water 130ml (Made in India)

Soothe your baby’s tummy and support healthy digestion with WoodWard’s Gripe Water, a trusted remedy used by generations of mothers for over 150 years.

Key Benefits:

Relieves Wind & Gripe: Contains Dill Seed Oil to relax the tummy and Sodium Bicarbonate to neutralize stomach acid, providing quick relief from trapped gas and discomfort.

Supports Digestion: Helps prevent digestive discomfort during teething and ensures smoother digestion.

Safe & Gentle: Alcohol-free, color-free, and Halal-certified – safe for everyday use.

Convenient Travel Pack: Easy to carry for on-the-go relief.

Ingredients: Oil of Dill Herb, Sodium Bicarbonate (Sarjikakshra)

Perfect For: Babies experiencing wind, colic, or digestive discomfort during teething.
